s2:Far-ultraviolet Flares on Accreting Protostars: Weak and Classical T Tauri Stell

rationale: The papers 'Photometric observations of flares on AD Leo from GWAC-F30 and TESS' and 'A Seven-Day Multi-Wavelength Flare Campaign on AU Mic I' provide direct observations of flare occurrences and characteristics, contributing evidence relevant to the rate of energetic flares.
